title: Minimum-rank parameters of complements of threshold Kneser graphs
summary: Let $J_{\ge s}(n,k)$ be the graph whose vertices are the $k$-subsets of $[n]$, with two distinct vertices adjacent whenever their intersection has size at least $s$. Equivalently, $J_{\ge s}(n,k)$ is the complement of a threshold Kneser graph. We determine both the symmetric minimum rank over an arbitrary infinite field and the real positive semidefinite minimum rank of this family.
